jobs.title: Associate Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Associate Implementation Manager is responsible for managing smaller client implementations, internal initiatives, and defined workstreams within larger implementation programs. This role serves as a developmental position within the Implementation organization, expanding from coordination and execution support into direct ownership of implementation planning, stakeholder communication, risk management, and delivery oversight. The Associate Implementation Manager partners closely with Implementation Managers, Implementation Consultants, Product, Technology, Operations, Training, QA, and Account Management teams to support successful implementation outcomes. While operating with guidance on more complex client engagements, this role is accountable for maintaining implementation plans, coordinating activities, managing risks, and ensuring assigned workstreams remain on track.

Responsibilities:

* Manage small-scale client implementations or internal initiatives from initiation through completion
* Own and maintain implementation plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables for assigned programs
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Product, Technology, Operations, QA, Training, Release Management, and Account Management
* Monitor implementation progress and proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers
* Facilitate recurring implementation meetings, status reviews, and working sessions
* Provide implementation status updates to internal and external stakeholders
* Support client communications, including status reporting, action item follow-up, and implementation readiness activities
* Maintain implementation documentation, decision logs, RAID logs, and project artifacts
* Assist in gathering implementation requirements and operational readiness needs
* Support release planning, implementation readiness, and launch coordination activities
* Escalate identified delivery concerns through established operational channels
* Ensure implementation activities align with organizational governance standards and delivery processes
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to implementation best practices
* Partner with senior implementation leaders to develop implementation strategies and delivery approaches

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience 2–5 years of experience in implementation management, project management, project coordination, delivery operations, or related fields
* Experience managing timelines, risks, dependencies, and cross-functional initiatives
* Strong working knowledge of Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Office, and implementation tracking tools
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and cross-functional delivery models
* Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Healthcare technology, specialty pharmacy, patient support services, or related industry experience preferred

Pay Range: USD $71,400.00 - USD $89,250.00 /Yr.

A Pharmacy Onboarding Technician performs a variety of administrative duties including prescription order entry, phone triage, billing, and insurance matters. We originated as part of an independent retail pharmacy, Tarrytown Pharmacy, which has been serving the local community since 1941. Through our dedication to provide excellence to our customers, we have grown from a small independent pharmacy to a multi-state long-term care pharmacy solution. If you are hardworking, dedicated and looking for a change in your career, we may have an opportunity for you!

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* A closed-door pharmacy work environment
* Opportunities to advance and grow your career

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Accurately and efficiently enter new orders and refill orders
* Properly handle order exceptions such as refill-too-soon, invalid orders, etc.
* Handle inbound and outbound calls with other facilities
* Identify orders that are valid and those that are invalid, and carry out appropriate order entry and workflow
* Adjudicate insurance claims and resolve rejections

* Ability to meet deadlines and function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
* Understands basic pharmacy language needed to interpret prescriptions
* Perform basic pharmacy calculations
* Is available for occasional overtime

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to withstand long hours of computer screen time
* Repetitive motion deskwork

jobs.title: Associate, Strategy & Operations, Merchant Onboarding & Experience
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The New Vertical Onboarding Strategy & Operations team drives a fast, seamless onboarding experience for merchants across the SMB segments. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to enhance visibility, streamline workflows, and reduce onboarding friction through scalable process and product improvements. Our mission is to ensure every merchant launches smoothly and efficiently, powered by data-driven insights and strong operational alignment.

**About the Role**
------------------

The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. This role acts as the single-threaded owner for SMB onboarding, ensuring merchants are launched quickly, accurately, and with minimal friction through data-driven insights, process automation, and clear ownership alignment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process Visibility & SLA Tracking: Build dashboards to monitor true onboarding timelines, identify delays, and surface insights to inform process and tooling improvements.
* Root Causing Blocked Cases: Develop a shared tracker for blocked cases, analyze trends, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve issues and implement sustainable fixes.
* Integrations Enablement: Design and refine onboarding workflows for new integration types (e.g., Shopify), and establish scalable processes as SMB Retail expands in 2026.
* Product & Tooling Guidance: Translate workflow gaps into actionable product requirements for systems like SFDC, and advocate for automation that reduces manual work.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with MXO, GTMT, IA, Sales, and Product to ensure end-to-end alignment on onboarding priorities and execution.
* Data & Insights: Create and maintain onboarding performance dashboards to measure success and track progress toward SLAs and OKRs.

You will report into the Manager of the Onboarding S&O pod on our Merchant Onboarding & Experience S&O team in our New Verticals Business Development organization.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Drive meaningful impact by transforming how SMB merchants onboard — reducing friction, accelerating launch timelines, and improving the overall merchant experience.
* Shape strategy and process from the ground up, building visibility tools, performance metrics, and scalable workflows that become the foundation for SMB onboarding excellence.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Ops, and GTMT to design solutions that balance speed, quality, and automation across the onboarding journey.
* Own high-visibility problem areas, using data to identify blockers and lead systemic, cross-team improvements that directly impact business growth.
* Be at the forefront of innovation, helping define the future of merchant onboarding as new integrations, verticals, and tooling capabilities are unlocked in 2026 and beyond

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment, where you've built and optimized processes from the ground up.
* You're proficient in SQL and comfortable using data to uncover insights, measure impact, and inform operational or strategic decisions.
* You thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, adapting quickly while maintaining a high bar for execution and detail.
* You're a strong cross-functional collaborator.
* You're known for your ability to "herd cats" — driving accountability, clarifying ownership, and keeping complex projects on track amid competing priorities.
* You possess a strategic and analytical mindset, able to diagnose root causes and translate findings into actionable, scalable solutions.
* You have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing without authority across seniority levels and functions.
* You're systems- and process-oriented, with a knack for identifying inefficiencies and translating workflow pain points into clear product or tooling requirements.
* You're impact-driven, motivated by improving merchant experiences and accelerating business outcomes through operational excellence.
* You're energized by ambiguity, eager to define structure, build visibility, and create sustainable frameworks that set the foundation for long-term success.

We expect this position to be filled by 10-17-2026

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. jobs.description:
Print Shop Onboarding & Support Specialist

About the role

InfoFlo Print is looking for someone with practical print shop experience to help customers get started with our software and provide ongoing support alongside our existing team member. This is a post-sales customer onboarding and support role.

Previous hands-on experience working in a print shop is required. You should understand print equipment, materials and inventory, estimating and pricing, finishing, and production workflows. We provide training on InfoFlo Print; you bring the practical print shop knowledge needed to understand customers' operations and questions. Prior experience with InfoFlo Print is not required.

Responsibilities

* Help new customers get started with InfoFlo Print and understand their shop's operations.

* After training, help configure equipment, products, materials, inventory, pricing, and production workflows in our software.

* Help shops translate click costs, material costs, labour, and finishing charges into accurate estimates and pricing.

* Train customers on using the software in their day-to-day work.

* Work alongside our support team to answer questions, troubleshoot setup and workflow issues, and follow through on solutions.

* Keep clear notes on customer setups and communicate product issues and feedback to the team.

Required qualifications

* Hands-on experience working in a print shop, such as digital, offset, or wide-format printing.

* Practical knowledge of print equipment, materials and inventory, estimating and pricing, finishing, and the workflow from estimate through production to invoice.

* Clear communication, patience, and the ability to explain processes to customers.

* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple customer setups.

* Comfort using computers, learning software, and working with Excel and pricing sheets.

Helpful, but not required

* Experience with print MIS software such as PrintSmith Vision, Printer's Plan, DocketManager, or shopVOX.

* Customer support, staff training, or customer onboarding experience.

* QuickBooks Online experience.

Location

This is a fully remote role. We welcome applicants based in Canada or the United States.

Please describe your print shop employment and relevant responsibilities in your application. Print shop experience is a mandatory requirement.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Describe your hands-on employment in a print shop: shop name(s), your role(s), length of employment, and your responsibilities involving equipment, materials/inventory, estimating/pricing, finishing, or production workflows.

Experience:

* hands-on print shop work: 1 year (required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  
  
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  
  
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

#### **The Role**

Global Seller Onboarding Specialistsmanage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process. They'll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square's platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions.

A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4) support Square's international expansion efforts.

#### **You Will**

* Drive world-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square's sellers, ensuring accountability to go-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.
* Cultivate strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.
* Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success.  
  Master Square's platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject-matter expert.
* Lead high-impact, multi-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.
* Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.
* Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process

**Your typical day will include:**

* Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation.
* Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.
* Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.

#### **You Have**

* BA/BS degree, preferably
* 4-5+ years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success.
* An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.
* Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.
* Ability to thrive within ambiguity and operate independently.
* Ability to drive and manage multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously; strong time management, and excellent written & verbal communication skills.
* Proven track record of success in delivering multiple complex projects in the technology industry while partnering with external and internal clients to attain deliverables.
* An ability to learn quickly as new products and organisational changes are released.
* Previous Project Management experience is expected.
* Experience in the POS, Payments or Tech industries is a plus.
* Experience in hardware installation and network configuration is a plus.
* Must be located in PST/MST time zone.
* Must be bilingual in English and Spanish.

jobs.description:

* Paid time off

**About Triton Medical Solutions**

Triton Medical Solutions is a medical billing and revenue cycle management company based in Tempe, Arizona. Since 2011, we have supported practices nationwide, including dental, orofacial pain, TMJ, dental sleep medicine, and CBCT radiology providers billing medical insurance.

**About the position**

We are seeking an experienced Implementation Billing Specialist to lead the day-to-day medical billing work for new clients as they onboard with Triton Medical Solutions. This is a hands-on role that combines full-cycle medical insurance billing with client implementation, workflow development, training, and coordination across internal teams.

You will manage claims from submission through payment and resolution, proactively address denials and outstanding accounts receivable, identify billing issues, and help establish accurate, efficient workflows tailored to each client. You will also track implementation tasks and deadlines, guide clients through billing procedures and software, and work closely with our Implementation Manager and other departments to keep onboarding on schedule.

As clients transition into ongoing billing operations, you will ensure workflows are documented, outstanding claims and follow-up needs are clearly communicated, and responsibilities are handed off smoothly. Following appropriate training, you will also provide designated backup for routine client questions, training, and implementation follow-up.

Our recommended platform for most new clients is AdvancedMD, although some clients retain their existing EHR or practice management software. The ideal candidate is an experienced medical biller who takes ownership, works independently, stays organized across multiple clients, communicates clearly, and follows issues through to resolution.

**What you will do**

* **Manage full-cycle medical billing:** Handle charge entry, claim submission, clearinghouse rejections, denial resolution, appeals, payer follow-up, payment posting, secondary billing, and accounts receivable management for clients during implementation.
* **Monitor claims and resolve billing issues:** Review claim accuracy and billing readiness, investigate underpayments and unpaid claims, monitor aging reports and filing deadlines, reconcile ERA/EOB payments, and identify recurring issues that affect reimbursement.
* **Coordinate client implementation:** Track implementation tasks, deadlines, outstanding issues, dependencies, and next steps across multiple clients. Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and communicate potential delays or barriers promptly.
* **Develop billing workflows and procedures:** Establish and document client-specific billing processes, checklists, and procedures to support accurate, consistent billing and a smooth transition to ongoing operations.
* **Train and support clients:** Guide clients through billing procedures, software workflows, claim requirements, and supporting documentation. Identify training needs and provide follow-up guidance.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work closely with the Implementation Manager, clients, billing operations, IT, and credentialing or contracting staff to resolve issues and keep implementation activities moving forward.
* **Provide designated backup coverage:** Following appropriate training, assist with routine client updates, implementation questions, scheduled training, and follow-up coordination.
* **Prepare complete billing handoffs:** Communicate open claims, accounts receivable status, denial and appeal deadlines, payer concerns, documented workflows, and unresolved tasks to the ongoing billing team.
* **Maintain accurate documentation and confidentiality:** Keep implementation trackers and client records current, follow through on commitments, and handle confidential information in accordance with HIPAA requirements.

**What we are looking for**

* **At least five years of hands-on medical insurance billing experience**, with a strong understanding of the full billing cycle from claim submission through payment posting and accounts receivable resolution.
* **Strong claims and accounts receivable expertise**, including rejections, denials, appeals, payer follow-up, ERA/EOB reconciliation, secondary billing, underpayments, aging reports, and timely filing requirements.
* **Knowledge of medical insurance billing requirements**, particularly commercial insurance and Medicare. The ability to research payer requirements and learn applicable Medicaid, managed care, and Medicare DME billing requirements is important.
* **Excellent organization and follow-through**, with the ability to independently manage multiple client accounts, prioritize competing deadlines, maintain accurate task trackers, and resolve issues without repeated reminders.
* **Problem-solving and analytical skills**, including the ability to investigate billing issues, identify root causes, recognize denial trends, recommend corrective actions, and escalate complex issues with a proposed next step.
* **Experience documenting and improving workflows**, developing procedures, identifying implementation gaps, and training clients or staff on billing processes and software.
* **Strong communication and client service skills**, with the ability to explain billing requirements clearly, coordinate with multiple teams, document decisions, and keep clients and coworkers informed.
* **Proficiency with billing systems and tools**, including EHR or practice management systems, clearinghouses, payer portals, spreadsheets, and task-tracking software, along with the ability to learn new platforms.

This is a remote position.

ACES Quality Management is on a mission to enable organizations to improve quality, reduce risk, strengthen compliance, and operate with confidence by delivering advanced technology. Through our leading quality management platform, we empower clients to elevate performance and stay ahead of risk. This role is accountable for executing defined implementation plans, configuring the ACES system to match client workflows, and providing training and onboarding support throughout the engagement. **Essential Functions / Responsibilities**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Delivers training and post-implementation support to client users, ensuring successful platform adoption
* Executes on the delivery of Implementation Plans, tracking milestones and maintaining accurate project documentation
* Assists the Implementation team with various tasks across active implementations as directed

Requirements:

* Strong organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities
* Strong work ethic and personal accountability
* Results-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable with change; able to manage complexity and time-sensitive deadlines

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present clearly to client and internal audiences

0%–5% travel. Potential travel includes MBA or other industry conferences, ACES Quality Management sponsored events such as the ACES Power User Summit, and onsite client visits where warranted.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Implementation
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**

Implementation is an essential differentiator for Rippling and a critical time in the customer journey. We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Platform Implementations to lead a team of 20+ team members and 3 Managers and drive the successful delivery of Platform solutions across Rippling’s client base. This leader will oversee end-to-end Platform onboarding, including Custom Reports, Workflows, Apps, SOWs, Dashboards, Analytics and additional foundational capabilities to support AI. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to refine processes, enhance client experiences, and ensure that Rippling delivers scalable, world-class implementations.

The ideal candidate for this role has a technical background, track record of managing high-performing implementation teams, building processes and systems, driving operational rigor, and a passion for operational excellence and customer impact. They must also handle ambiguity, unstructured situations, and scale while leading a team with high standards.

**What you will do**

* Own the strategy and execution of Platform implementations from client kickoff through go-live.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with implementation projects, act as an escalation point for complex client implementations and technical issues.
* Partner with cross-functional leaders (Product, Sales, Engineering, Customer Success) to continuously improve delivery processes and client outcomes.
* Collaborate with sales and post-sales teams to ensure a seamless transition from sales to implementation to account management & customer support.
* Develop, monitor, and manage key performance metrics
* Hire, mentor, and grow high-performing teams that consistently meet and exceed monthly goals and targets and deliver high-quality implementation services to clients.
* Create and optimize playbooks, tooling, and frameworks to drive consistency, efficiency, and scalability across implementations.
* Drive adoption of best practices in project management, change management, and client communication.
* Foster a culture relentlessly focused on delighting customers in Implementation & maximizing adoption of Rippling’s products and services

**What you will need**

* You have 10+ years of professional experience leading an Implementation or Customer Success team within a fast-paced environment, startup, or SaaS organization
* At least 2+ years of experience leading and developing people managers
* Deep understanding of systems and operations with B2B or B2C products
* Proven track record in hiring and overseeing distributed teams
* Proven track record of success in scaling teams and maintaining SLAs as well as other key performance metrics
* A data-driven approach to developing, tracking and optimizing performance metrics
* Self-motivated, detail-attentive, action-driven with the ability to take initiative, execute, and follow-through
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts - able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Eager for a very hands-on role, where you’ll be asked to take on and run with a range of initiatives outside your comfort zone and learn quickly
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented, with great follow-through on initiatives big and small

**About the team**

Rippling’s Platform Specialist team is responsible for ensuring customers see incredible business transformations by maximizing the value of our core Platform - including custom workflows, advanced reports/analytics, apps, permission profiles, and approvals. Platform Specialist engagements are consultative and customized based on the customers’ unique needs/pain points.

The team is currently spread across the USA, Sydney and Dublin and is expanding geographically.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

Compensation package: base + 10% bonus + equity

* **Commission is not guaranteed**

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
117,300 - 175,950 USD per year(US Tier 1)  
105,570 - 167,152 USD per year(US Tier 2)

jobs.title: Implementation Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We’re on a mission to fix dental software - and we’re not playing small. Our platform replaces clunky, outdated systems with modern, cloud-based, AI-powered technology built to actually work at scale. From practice management to imaging to revenue cycle automation, we’re tearing down the old infrastructure and rebuilding the future of dentistry. Planet DDS is the fastest-growing provider of dental practice management solutions and the #1 cloud platform for DSOs and multi-location groups.

Here, you won’t just join a team - you’ll join a movement. We want bold thinkers who are ambitious enough to push limits, empathetic enough to work as one, and accountable enough to own big outcomes. Trust is our currency, collaboration is our edge, and impact is our fuel. If you’re ready to grow fast, challenge the status quo, and help reinvent an entire industry, Planet DDS is where you belong.

The **Implementation Solutions Consultant** will lead the onboarding of dental and orthodontic customers ranging from small independent practices to large multi-site organizations. This role sits at the intersection of technical configuration and project leadership you'll design workflows, configure systems, advise customers on dental and orthodontic practice management best practices, and coordinate across internal teams to drive successful go-lives. You'll also play a role in shaping and improving our implementation methodology as our processes mature.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end implementation projects for customers of varying size and complexity, from single-location practices to large multi-site organizations.

* Design and configure system workflows tailored to each customer's practice model and operational needs.

* Consult with customers on industry best practices for dental and orthodontic practice management workflows during onboarding.

* Collaborate cross-functionally (Training, Support, Product, Account Management) to keep implementations on track and ensure a smooth go-live.

* Operate fluidly between hands-on technical configuration and project management responsibilities — timelines, stakeholder communication (including executive levels), risk mitigation.

* Identify friction points in the implementation process and feed insights back into ongoing process improvement efforts.

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

* 2–4 years of experience in software implementation (SaaS strongly preferred).

* Comfort operating across both technical (system configuration) and interpersonal/PM (client-facing delivery) responsibilities.

* Strong communication skills and ability to translate technical configuration into plain, actionable guidance for customers.
* This role requires someone who operates independently and exercises strong judgment — someone who identifies issues and drives solutions rather than waiting for direction. We're looking for a self-starter who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks, and solves the problem at hand.
* The strongest candidates will bring a mix of consulting instincts, project discipline, and genuine curiosity about dental and orthodontic workflows. Specifically, we look for people who:
  + Ask sharp questions upfront and translate the answers into a clear project plan without being hand-held.
  + Communicate with confidence at all levels, from front office staff to customer executives.
  + Stay composed when implementations get complicated, and solve problems rather than escalate them.
  + Have enough technical depth to configure systems confidently, and enough emotional intelligence to bring customers along through the process.
  + Treat process improvement as part of the job, not someone else's problem.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in dental, orthodontic, or adjacent healthcare IT environments.
* Familiarity with practice management workflows including scheduling, billing, and clinical documentation.
* Exposure to multi-site or enterprise customer implementations.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Required to sit for prolonged periods of time

Planet DDS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: EHR Analyst
jobs.description:
Our vision is a world of peaceful relationships with food, weight, and body image, where everyone with an eating disorder can experience recovery. We believe that exceptional, individualized care leads to lasting recovery from eating disorders. That's why our teams are comprised of compassionate, dedicated professionals from a variety of backgrounds who collaborate to provide the very best evidence-based care for our clients at all levels of care.

**Position Summary:**

The EHR Analyst will be an integral member of the EHR team. They will provide 'real time' support to the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team and business staff, help work through claim and remittance technical issues, offer superior service and responsiveness to internal customers and work with vendors and members of the EHR team to facilitate fixes/solutions/enhancements to the billing system. They will assist with system upgrades and test scripts.

**Schedule**

* Monday - Friday, typical business hours

**Location**

* Remote, must be US Based and have the right to work for any employer in the US without restrictions

**Compensation Disclosure**

Starting salary range between $70,000 - $80,000

***Final Compensation offered will be within pay range based on qualifications/experience met for the position***

**How an EHR Billing Analyst Empowers Recovery:**

* Address billing discrepancies received from claim remittances.
* Handle billing production problem/issues resolution for all end users.
* Play a key/lead role in the overall billing support and optimization of the EHR system.
* Serve as the point of contact for all EHR billing corrections for the billing team.
* Responsible for maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction with end users.
* Provide reliable tracking mechanics for changes to the EHR system.
* Maintain accurate records of all billing changes made and results of inquiries via ticketing system.
* Assist EHR team members with researching functionality for new enhancements.
* Work with Training to update support and maintenance documentation.
* Provide key knowledge on the development and implementation of standardized, streamlined billing content.
* Participate in validation testing of new design/build and provide implementation support.
* Assist in the implementation, design, build, test, and maintenance of systems to support clinical and/or financial processes.
* Assist in EHR build requirements when needed.
* Contribute to tasks and projects as assigned by management as necessary to help in the development of application test strategies and plans.
* Effectively communicate the status of tasks/projects to management and ensure timely and quality delivery of all deliverables.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum two years' experience with myAvatar, Sigmund, AURA, SmartCare, or with another EHR system strongly preferred.
* Willingness to learn and develop leadership skills.
* Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Must be able to communicate effectively with billing staff and leadership.
* Ability to understand and interpret billing concepts/requirements.
* Knowledge of billing/CMS regulations/837i/837p loop and segments required.
* Knowledge of claim remittance codes/posting codes/service codes.
* Self-reliant individual with strong multitasking skills.
* Must have excellent follow-through and attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritize work appropriately in a changing environment.
* Bachelor Degree in Health Information Management preferred.

**Competencies:**

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Solid Interpersonal skills with the demonstrated ability to develop and maintain productive relationships.
* Demonstrate initiative and exercise good judgement (e.g, in starting tasks, asking questions, identifying, and discussing problems, ability to structure own work, stay on task).
* Ability to prioritize and adapt to changing priorities.
* Shows passion for our business, clients, and values.

**What we offer:**

**Employee Benefits:** We understand the importance of a well-rounded benefits package. That's why we're dedicated to providing a range of plans to meet your needs.

For full-time employees, we offer:

* HSA and PPO insurance with HSA or FSA options (Blue Cross Blue Shield)
* Dental insurance (Delta Dental)
* Vision insurance (EyeMed)
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* Company-paid life insurance
* 401(k) plan available two months after start date
* Company 401(k) matching for up to 50% of your contribution, up to 6% of your compensation

Paid time off is a crucial part of maintaining work and life balance. Our generous PTO plan accrues annually and begins with your first whole pay period. Eligible employees enjoy seven paid holidays and one floating holiday in addition to their regular PTO.
